review_required_from: Member 1: scientific schema and ranking methodology
Member 4 / QA: criteria freeze (CP1 plan B4)
purpose: Ranks how well an investigation's evidence answers a stated research question. It is not a fire-danger, fire-risk or hazard score, and no score is a probability.
notes: These weights are an editorial proposal. They are not NASA-certified and not approved by the team.
Under CP1 plan B4 the approved file is committed alone as config/ranking_criteria_v1.json before any ranking output, and is never edited afterwards. This file is the proposal for that step.
Only measured and interpreted evidence is scored. Quoted source statements are context only.

criteria.description: How directly the evidence addresses the question's fire-safety topics, quantities and target environment.
criteria.scoring_rule: Mean of the parts the question specifies: (topics covered / topics asked), (quantities with a reported value / quantities asked), and 1 if any record is tagged for the target environment else 0.

criteria.description: How well the experimental conditions match those the question specifies.
criteria.scoring_rule: Conditions matched by at least one record / conditions specified. Exact match for categories, inclusive range for numbers. An unreported condition counts as unmatched and is listed as missing. 0 for everyone, marked 'not assessed', if no conditions are given.

criteria.description: How completely each value can be traced back to its NASA source.
criteria.scoring_rule: Mean over records of the best source's share of 4 checks: http(s) URL, retrieval date, exact quote, locator/archive id/DOI. An interpretation takes the mean of the records it is derived from; unresolved inputs count as 0.

criteria.description: How much of the record the source actually reports.
criteria.scoring_rule: Mean over records of the share reported among: the 8 condition keys, test id, and for quantities the value and the uncertainty.
